name: AccuRanker
description_en:
AccuRanker is a hosted rank-tracking and SEO reporting platform. It combines location/device-specific keyword checks, SERP inspection, landing-page monitoring, grouping, reporting and integrations. AccuLLM adds a prompt-based view of brand mentions, citations and visibility in AI answers, with its own active-plan requirement for MCP data access.

It is a candidate for an agency or in-house SEO team that needs a repeatable measurement panel across sites and markets. The useful evaluation is not just whether a number appears: define the exact query configuration, understand how it consumes quota, retain the metric calculation and inspect the underlying SERP or AI response when a trend changes. The October 21, 2026 Share of Voice/model release materially changes how some figures should be interpreted. This research read public originals and pricing selectors without connecting customer data, importing keywords or measuring tracking accuracy.
description_zh:
AccuRanker 是托管排名跟踪与 SEO 报告平台，结合按位置／设备的关键词检查、SERP 查看、落地页监控、分组、报告及集成。AccuLLM 增加基于 prompt 的 AI 回答品牌提及、引用及可见性视图，经 MCP 访问其数据需独立活动计划。

它可供需跨站点／市场建立可重复测量面板的机构或站内 SEO 团队评估。关键不只看是否有数字：应定义准确查询配置、理解额度消耗、保留指标计算，趋势变化时查看底层 SERP 或 AI 回答。2026 年 10 月 21 日 Share of Voice／模型发布实质改变部分数字读法。本研究读取公开原文及价格选择器，未连接客户数据、导关键词或测跟踪准确率。

core_features.explanation_en: Track a term by country, engine, device and optional location.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按国家、引擎、设备及可选位置跟踪词。

core_features.explanation_en: Compare the ranking URL with the page you intended to rank.
core_features.explanation_zh: 比较实际排名 URL 与预期排名页。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep CTR model and volume source explicit when comparing visibility.
core_features.explanation_zh: 比较可见性时明确 CTR 模型及搜索量来源。

core_features.explanation_en: Drill into an engine response and its matched brands/sources.
core_features.explanation_zh: 下钻引擎回答及其匹配品牌／来源。

en: Monitor a stable query/device/location panel across client sites.
Investigate landing-page mismatches before interpreting ranking changes.
Report modeled visibility separately from observed GSC clicks and prompt-panel AI presence.
zh: 跨客户站点监控稳定查询／设备／位置面板。
解释排名变化前调查落地页不匹配。
分别报告模型可见性、实测 GSC 点击及 prompt 面板 AI 出现。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Annotate model changes and corroborate unusual results before action.
steps.zh: 标模型变化，行动前交叉核异常结果。

steps.en: Check actual report access, filters and account overage rates.
steps.zh: 查真实报告访问、筛选及账户超额费率。

items.en: Engine/device/location combinations multiply tracked keyword usage.
items.zh: 引擎／设备／位置组合增加跟踪词用量。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Public page displays Professional $224/month with 2,000 keywords selected and Expert $764/month with 10,000 selected; Enterprise above 25K is quoted. Annual payment advertises 10% off, but clicking Yearly did not change the returned browser price snapshot, so no annual total or normalized price is inferred. Professional includes daily tracking/GSC/GA/reports; Expert adds dynamic tags, AI CTR, AR volume and unlimited read API; Enterprise adds write API/BigQuery/raw SERP HTML. This tiering differs from broad homepage unlimited-API wording. AccuLLM has separate plan access; its rates, tax/currency code, current trial and permanent free eligibility were not established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 公开页显示 Professional $224／月并选 2,000 词，Expert $764／月并选 10,000 词，超过 25K 的 Enterprise 询价。年付宣传九折，但点 Yearly 未改变返回浏览器价格快照，因此不推年总额或标准化价格。Professional 含每日跟踪／GSC／GA／报告，Expert 增动态标签、AI CTR、AR 量及不限读取 API，Enterprise 增写入 API／BigQuery／原始 SERP HTML。分档不同于主页广义不限 API。AccuLLM 另需计划访问，其费率、税／币种代码、当前试用及永久免费资格未确定。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: One query can consume several tracked-keyword units
sections.title_zh: 一个查询可消耗多个跟踪关键词单位
sections.en: Domain setup chooses a group, default engine/country/location, subdomain inclusion and optional exact matching. Keywords can come from manual entry, suggestions, GSC or CSV. Each country, engine, device and location combination counts separately: Google and Bing on desktop and mobile count as four, not one. A blank location means country-level tracking. Editorial launch panel: begin with a small matrix of actual target markets and inspect the total before adding the complete list. A domain default is a configuration convenience, not proof that imported rows use the desired scope.
sections.zh: 域名设置选择组、默认引擎／国家／位置、是否含子域及可选精确匹配。词可手输、建议、GSC 或 CSV 导入。国家、引擎、设备、位置组合分别计数，Google 与 Bing 各桌面／移动算四个而非一个；空位置是国家级。编辑上线面板：先建少量真实目标市场矩阵，加全表前核总数。域默认仅是配置便利，不能证明导入行使用准确范围。

sections.title_en: Historical import needs the historical template
sections.en: Bulk Import offers a keyword-only example and a different optional-column example for historic data. The guide requires yyyy-mm-dd dates, empty unranked values rather than a dash, and correctly capitalized headers. Import duration depends on volume. Editorial migration: preserve the old export, preview a representative file with device/location context and compare known historical dates after ingestion before replacing a reporting baseline. An accepted file is not proof of equivalent rank methodology across vendors, and a new measurement configuration cannot manufacture missing old observations. No CSV was uploaded here.
sections.zh: Bulk Import 提供仅关键词示例及另含可选列的历史数据示例。指南要求 yyyy-mm-dd 日期、未排名留空而非横线、标题大小写正确，导入耗时受数量影响。编辑迁移：保留旧导出，用具设备／位置上下文的代表性文件，摄入后对照已知历史日期，再替换报告基线。接受文件不能证明跨供应商排名方法等同，新测量配置不能制造缺失旧观察。本研究未上传 CSV。

sections.title_en: Adjusted rank and Base Rank answer different questions
sections.title_zh: 调整排名与 Base Rank 回答不同问题
sections.en: Ignore rules can exclude top domains, local results or featured snippets from the displayed rank. Base Rank preserves the original unadjusted position. Domain exclusion applies to its leading results, whereas local-result exclusion removes all local results. Ignore changes affect present/future rankings, not past ones. Preferred URL separately flags whether the highest-ranking page matches your intended landing page; it does not change Google’s selection or set a canonical. Editorial diagnosis: keep the base/adjusted rank, exclusions, date and actual URL together before calling a change an SEO gain or cannibalization problem.
sections.zh: 忽略规则可从显示排名排除顶部域名、本地结果或精选摘要，Base Rank 保留原始位置。域排除针对领先结果，本地排除移除全部本地项；忽略变更仅影响当前／未来，不改过去。Preferred URL 另标最高排名页是否匹配预期，不改变 Google 选择或设置 canonical。编辑诊断：判断 SEO 提升或关键词竞争问题前，一并保留原始／调整排名、排除项、日期及真实 URL。

sections.title_en: Share of Voice estimates clicks rather than counting them
sections.title_zh: Share of Voice 估计点击，不统计真实点击
sections.en: The updated help defines Share of Voice as CTR × monthly search volume, summed across the current keyword view. Only top-twenty organic results receive CTR; below that the metric is zero. Google keywords can use Dynamic or Static CTR and AR or Keyword Planner volume; other engines retain their static calculation. The same choices affect Traffic Value and Share of Voice %. Settings apply across displayed history, but historical dynamic CTR retains the model used on each date. Editorial comparison: record configuration and scope beside exports; use GSC for actual clicks, and do not infer zero visits from zero modeled visibility.
sections.zh: 更新帮助定义 Share of Voice 为 CTR × 月搜索量，汇总当前关键词视图；仅自然前二十名获 CTR，更低为零。Google 可用 Dynamic／Static CTR 及 AR／Keyword Planner 量，其他引擎保留静态计算。同一选择影响 Traffic Value 与 Share of Voice %。设置作用全部显示历史，但历史动态 CTR 保留当天模型。编辑比较：导出旁记录配置及范围，真实点击看 GSC，不能以模型可见性为零推真实访问为零。

sections.title_en: The October 21 model cutover can create a chart step
sections.title_zh: 10 月 21 日模型切换可造成图表台阶
sections.en: The release log merges Share of Voice and AI Share of Voice into one configurable metric. It also introduces a rebuilt Dynamic CTR model from October 21, 2026 at 09:00 UTC, leaving earlier CTR values unchanged; a downward step can therefore reflect model change without a ranking loss. Static CTR is unaffected. API/export field names remain, but values follow the selected calculation. Editorial monthly report: annotate the cutover and retain settings instead of interpreting an uninterrupted field name as an unchanged measurement series. Vendor training-scale and expected-drop claims were not independently validated.
sections.zh: 更新日志将 Share of Voice 与 AI Share of Voice 合并为可配置指标，并从 2026 年 10 月 21 日 09:00 UTC 使用重建 Dynamic CTR，较早 CTR 不变；所以下降台阶可能来自模型而非排名丢失。Static CTR 不受影响。API／导出字段名保留，但值跟随所选计算。编辑月报：标模型切换并保留设置，不能以字段名连续认定测量序列不变。供应商训练规模及预期降幅未独立验证。

sections.title_en: A local-volume display change can rewrite the historical view
sections.title_zh: 本地搜索量显示变化可重算历史视图
sections.en: The search-volume guide describes monthly estimates, usually a twelve-month average, with a different last-month treatment for Naver. Local and country values are stored; switching the selected basis changes historical metrics immediately. AR Search Volume distinguishes device estimates, unlike the regular combined volume column. Editorial local-service report: retain location, volume source and device next to each comparison, especially when another person changes account/domain display settings. A search-volume estimate and modeled CTR are not observed website sessions or revenue, and the vendor’s precision claims were not independently tested.
sections.zh: 搜索量指南描述月度估计，通常十二月均值，Naver 用上月。已存本地及国家量，切换依据立即改变历史指标。AR Search Volume 区分设备估计，普通量列合并设备。编辑本地服务报告：在比较旁保留位置、量来源及设备，尤其其他人改账户／域显示设置时。估算搜索量及模型 CTR 不是实测网站会话或收入，供应商精度主张未独测。

sections.title_en: A sudden missing rank needs corroboration
sections.title_zh: 突然丢失排名需交叉证据
sections.en: The rank-tracking page describes daily updates and on-demand domain refresh every two hours, not a continuously observed live SERP. In its October 19 article the vendor describes history comparisons and second fetches for suspicious result pages, with less coverage for new terms lacking history. It recommends checking unusual results against neighboring days, competing results and GSC before acting. These are vendor methods and troubleshooting suggestions, not verified causes for every drop. Editorial response: preserve query/device/location and the observed result, request a fresh check and compare independent site signals before changing a working page.
sections.zh: 排名页描述每日更新及域按需每两小时刷新，不是连续观察实时 SERP。供应商 10 月 19 日文章描述历史比较及可疑页二次获取，新词缺历史时覆盖较少，建议行动前对照相邻日、竞品结果及 GSC。这是供应商方法／故障建议，不证明每次下降原因。编辑响应：保留查询／设备／位置及所见结果，要求新检查，改正常页前比较独立站点信号。

sections.title_en: Brand spelling and competitor definitions change the AI panel
sections.title_zh: 品牌拼写及竞品定义改变 AI 面板
sections.en: AccuLLM setup defines brand spellings, domain, request country, prompts and pinned competitors. Its metric guide says domain matching is case-insensitive, while brand-spelling matching is case-sensitive. Rank is mention order among defined brands, not a general search rank; competitor/spelling changes apply only to future responses. Per-engine visibility is binary and the aggregate averages engines equally. Editorial baseline: review spellings and the competitor list, preserve the prompt/country/engine panel and inspect original responses. Adding a previously absent brand can change future ranking denominators without demonstrating a real loss of audience attention.
sections.zh: AccuLLM 设置品牌拼写、域、请求国家、prompt 及置顶竞品。指标指南说域匹配不分大小写，品牌拼写则区分。Rank 是已定义品牌的提及顺序，不是通用搜索排名；竞品／拼写变更仅影响未来回答。逐引擎可见性为二元，汇总等权平均。编辑基线：核拼写及竞品表，保留 prompt／国家／引擎面板并查原文。新增此前缺品牌可改未来排名参照，不证明真实受众注意力损失。

sections.title_en: Workspaces and public reports expose different scopes
sections.title_zh: 工作区与公开报告暴露不同范围
sections.en: Workspace access follows assigned groups and their domains; Admins/Super Users automatically receive All Groups. The guide lists two workspaces by default with support for additional needs. A public report is a separate always-updating link, not a frozen export; a logged-in account holder can edit its structure. Editorial agency setup: confirm the viewer’s actual group/domain access and every public report’s filter scope before sharing. The public guide does not establish expiry/password or immutable revision controls. A saved keyword filter alone should not be treated as an access-control boundary.
sections.zh: 工作区访问跟随分配组及其域，Admin／Super User 自动拥有 All Groups。指南列默认两个工作区，额外需求联系支持。公开报告是另一个持续更新链接，不是冻结导出；登录账户持有者可改结构。编辑机构设置：分享前核查看者真实组／域访问及每份公开报告筛选范围。公开指南未确定到期／密码或不可变版本控制，保存关键词筛选本身不能当访问边界。

sections.title_en: Report scheduling waits for collection; MCP needs explicit fields
sections.title_zh: 报告排程等待采集，MCP 需明确字段
sections.en: Scheduled reports choose a domain, PDF/CSV/Sheets type, language/template, cadence and recipients. They send after the day’s keyword update, so the nominal date is not a proven exact-time delivery SLA. MCP tools separately read domains, keywords, landing pages, tags and AccuLLM brands/prompts, with fields and AND/OR filters. KPI dates compare two days; history dates define a returned range. AccuLLM tools need an active AccuLLM plan. Editorial automated readout: retain the filters, dates, calculation settings and original response links so an assistant’s narrative can be traced to the requested panel. No connector or report email was executed.
sections.zh: 定时报告选域、PDF／CSV／Sheets、语言／模板、周期及收件人，在当日关键词更新后发送，名义日期不证明准确时间投递 SLA。MCP 分别读域、关键词、落地页、标签及 AccuLLM 品牌／prompt，支持字段及 AND／OR 筛选。KPI 日期比较两日，历史日期定义返回区间，AccuLLM 工具需活动计划。编辑自动读报：保留筛选、日期、计算设置及原回答链接，使代理叙述可追到所请求面板。未执行连接器或报告邮件。

sections.title_en: Daily overage is separate from refreshing the same terms
sections.title_zh: 每日超额不同于刷新同一批词
sections.en: Dynamic Keyword Usage counts the number of tracked keywords each day and sums excess keyword-days through the billing period. On-demand refreshes of the same set do not add usage in that guide. Actual unit rates are shown inside the account rather than established in public text. Upgrades apply immediately with the difference charged; downgrades wait until next payment. The refund policy offers a request within fourteen days of the first purchase. Editorial campaign budget: count configuration combinations and temporary extra days, then inspect account rates; deleting a temporary keyword is not proof the accrued overage was reversed.
sections.zh: Dynamic Keyword Usage 每日数跟踪词，计费期汇总超额关键词日；该指南中刷新同一批词不增加用量。准确单价在账户内显示，公开文字未确定。升级立即生效并收差额，降档到下次付款。退款政策提供首次购买十四天内申请。编辑活动预算：数配置组合及临时超额日数，再查账户费率；删除临时词不能证明已产生超额被撤销。

seo.title_en: AccuRanker: query quotas, Share of Voice changes and AI visibility
seo.title_zh: AccuRanker：查询额度、Share of Voice 变更及 AI 可见性
seo.description_en: Review AccuRanker keyword combinations, adjusted ranks, October CTR changes, prompt definitions, reports and daily overage.
seo.description_zh: 核 AccuRanker 关键词组合、调整排名、十月 CTR 变化、prompt 定义、报告及每日超额。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate AccuRanker measurement configuration and reporting
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: No live domain, keyword import, OAuth/GSC connection, MCP request, rank refresh, report email or purchase executed. Tracking accuracy and vendor anomaly/CTR statistics not independently tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未操作域、导词、OAuth／GSC、MCP、刷新、报告邮件或购买；跟踪准确率及供应商异常／CTR 统计未独测。

research_gaps.en: Displayed pricing toggle behavior, exact currency/tax, active trial/free eligibility, AccuLLM rates, daily overage unit price and cancellation data-access timing remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 价格切换行为、准确币种／税、活动试用／免费资格、AccuLLM 费率、每日超额单价及取消后数据访问时点未核。

research_gaps.en: Older help and feature pages retain AI Share of Voice labels/percentage toggles superseded by the October 21 release; actual account UI/export behavior not operated.
research_gaps.zh: 旧帮助及功能页保留被 10 月 21 日发布替代的 AI Share of Voice 名称／百分比开关，未操作真实账户 UI／导出。

research_gaps.en: Full language/region list, fixed retention, public-link security controls, all engine-format coverage and source-code licence remain unknown.
research_gaps.zh: 完整语言／地区、固定保留期、公开链接安全控制、全部引擎格式覆盖及源码许可未知。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
